summary: Plan an original Karis Medical website for Uganda, using Mayo Clinic only as information-architecture and usability inspiration, without copying branding, copy, or assets. Choose the stack after confirming clinic facts, appointment and staff-management needs, authorized assets, and hosting constraints; planning authorizes no provisioning, deployment, or paid cloud resources.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace was inspected and is empty; no framework, backend, datastore, or hosting has been selected.

questions.question: Which language for a React-based public website? This is provisional until appointment and staff-management needs are confirmed.
questions.rationale: No stack was selected. These are frontend language choices only, not a decision against Python/Django or PHP on the server.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for maintainability and checked component and form contracts.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Suitable when your maintainers prefer JavaScript without static types.

questions.question: Which public-site framework do you prefer? Use the free-text answer to request Django or PHP instead, or leave the recommendation for needs-based review.
questions.rationale: A public information site provisionally favors Next.js. Staff-managed content or appointment operations may favor Django and its admin; conventional PHP-only shared hosting may favor PHP. Revise the service architecture before plan approval if those needs apply.

options.label: React + Next.js
options.description: Recommended for a searchable public clinic website with pre-rendered service pages; no separate API needed for a contact-only first release.

options.label: React + Vite
options.description: Good for an interactive client-side application; less directly suited to a content-led public site without additional rendering work.

questions.question: Which pages and languages are needed, and do you have an authorized Karis logo, brand colors, clinic photos, or approved copy? State what is unavailable.
questions.answer: Proposed pages: Home, About Karis, Services, Patient Information, Appointment/Contact, and Privacy. English initially. Assets and approved copy are not yet supplied; confirm availability. Use original Karis branding and copy, with Mayo Clinic-inspired navigation and readability only.
questions.rationale: Page scope, language needs, and asset rights remain unconfirmed. Do not reuse Mayo branding, text, layouts verbatim, or proprietary media; do not invent medical claims or present stock subjects as Karis clinicians.
questions.recommendedChoice: Proposed pages: Home, About Karis, Services, Patient Information, Appointment/Contact, and Privacy. English initially. Assets and approved copy are not yet supplied; confirm availability. Use original Karis branding and copy, with Mayo Clinic-inspired navigation and readability only.

questions.question: Provide Karis's verified town/address, public phone/email, actual services, and opening hours. Include clinician details only if authorized; mark anything unknown.
questions.answer: Karis Medical, Uganda. Town/address, phone/email, actual services, opening hours, clinician details, and credentials: not yet supplied. Keep unknown facts unpublished until verified.
questions.rationale: Only the clinic name and country are known. Never invent contact details, doctors, accreditation, hours, emergency availability, or clinical outcomes. No patient information should be entered in this planning form.
questions.recommendedChoice: Karis Medical, Uganda. Town/address, phone/email, actual services, opening hours, clinician details, and credentials: not yet supplied. Keep unknown facts unpublished until verified.

questions.question: What should appointments do at launch? This determines whether a backend, private storage, and staff sign-in are needed.
questions.rationale: No booking workflow was specified. A browser-only form must not display delivery or booking success; never describe an appointment request as a confirmed appointment. Reconcile auth, data stores, and services with this answer before producing the plan.

options.label: Contact only
options.description: Recommended initial scope: verified call/contact links; no patient data collection or claim that a booking was made.

options.label: Appointment requests
options.description: Receive minimal contact and preferred-time details through a verified delivery channel; staff confirm later. Requires privacy, retention, and delivery design.

options.label: Staff-managed appointments and content
options.description: Staff sign-in, scheduling/content administration, and a database; evaluate Django before committing to React plus a separate backend.

options.label: Existing booking provider
options.description: Integrate a clinic-approved existing service; provide its name and requirements without sharing credentials.

questions.question: Do you already have a domain/host, a monthly budget, or a PHP/Python hosting restriction? No hosting purchase or deployment will occur during planning.
questions.rationale: The user has not approved Azure or paid resources. The planning workflow's Azure tooling and storage labels are not authorization to provision or deploy any service.

options.label: Undecided; plan locally first
options.description: Keep hosting portable and costs uncommitted; compare options after the functional needs are clear.

options.label: Existing PHP shared hosting
options.description: Provide the host's capabilities, not credentials; PHP may be the practical choice if Node.js/Python are unavailable.

options.label: Existing Python-capable hosting
options.description: Provide capabilities and budget; suitable for Django when staff workflows are needed.

options.label: Existing Node.js or static hosting
options.description: Provide capabilities and budget; assess Next.js server support versus a static export.

questions.question: Which storage capabilities are needed? Blob Storage denotes the media capability here, not approval to purchase Azure; reconcile this with the appointment scope.
questions.rationale: A visual clinic website is expected to serve authorized image assets, so media storage is represented. This does not mandate Azure hosting or a separate paid storage resource. No patient database is recommended before appointment requirements are confirmed.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Only if no persistent records, stored/served media, uploads, queues, or caches are needed.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Image/file storage capability for clinic media. Bundled authorized site assets may avoid a separate managed cloud store; determine this in the plan.

options.label: Queue Storage
options.description: Only if an approved asynchronous processing workflow requires a queue.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Consider for staff-managed content or appointment records; not needed for contact links alone.

options.label: CosmosDB
options.description: Document database; no identified need for the initial site.

options.label: Redis
options.description: Shared cache; no identified need for the initial site.

options.label: Azure SQL
options.description: SQL Server option only if explicitly justified; no identified initial requirement.

questions.question: Does the application need user sign-in, including staff accessing private administration or appointment features?
questions.rationale: No staff or patient accounts have been requested. If staff-managed appointments/content are selected, authentication must be included and the architecture reconciled before plan approval.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Needed for staff administration or any private account-based application features.

options.label: No
options.description: Recommended for an initial public information/contact-only site with no private application features.
